info.name: Saudi Driving License Verification API
info.description:
Full Postman collection for the Saudi Driving License Verification API.

Base URL is stored in the `base_url` collection variable — change it once to target any environment.

Endpoints:
  GET  /              — Liveness ping
  GET  /health        — YOLO + VLM backend status
  POST /verify        — Single image verification
  POST /verify-batch  — Batch image verification (up to 2000 files)

How to use:
  1. Start the API:  uvicorn api:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
  2. Set the `base_url` variable (default: http://localhost:8000)
  3. Run Health first to confirm everything is ready
  4. Use Verify or Verify Batch for license extraction

variable.description: Change this to your server address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8000

request.description: Simple liveness check. Returns 200 if the API process is running.

Checks:
- YOLO model is found on disk
- Ollama server is reachable
- Target VLM model is loaded in Ollama

Returns `status: ok` when everything is ready, `status: degraded` if the YOLO model is missing.

formdata.description: Your reference or user ID — echoed back in the response (required)
License image — supported: jpg, jpeg, png, webp, heic, tiff, bmp, gif, pdf (required)

request.description:
Verify a single Saudi driving license image.

**Internal pipeline:**
1. Validate file extension
2. YOLO detection → locate license in image (≥ 0.70 confidence required)
3. Crop license region (+ 15 px padding)
4. Pre-process: resize to 1200 px wide, sharpen
5. VLM OCR via Ollama (qwen2.5vl:7b) → extract text fields
6. Post-process: normalise dates, trim strings
7. Validation: check required fields, date formats, expiry status

**Supported file types:** jpg · jpeg · png · webp · heic · tiff · bmp · gif · pdf

**Returns:**
- `200` — success with full `license_data` and `validation` blocks
- `422` — bad image extension or no license detected
- `500` — OCR pipeline error
- `503` — YOLO model not found on server

item.name: Verify Batch — Multiple License Images (up to 2000)

exec: pm.test("Total equals results array length", function () {

formdata.description: Document type applied to all images in this batch (required)
Your batch reference ID — echoed in the response (required)
Image file #1 — add as many 'files' rows as needed (up to 2000)
Image file #2 — duplicate this row for each additional image

request.description:
Verify 1–2000 license images in a single HTTP request.

**How to send many files in Postman:**
1. In the Body tab, select `form-data`
2. Add a row: Key = `files`, Type = `File`, select your image
3. To add more images: duplicate the row (click ⋯ → Duplicate)
   Each row must have Key = `files`

**Response format:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "batch_id": "uuid",
  "total": N,
  "succeeded": X,
  "failed": Y,
  "results": [ ... ]   ← flat array, one entry per image
}
```

Results are in the same order as the uploaded files. Each entry has its own `success` flag — mixed success/failure is normal.

**Server-side limit:** 2000 files per request (set `BATCH_MAX_FILES` env var to change).
